inputMethod: InputSystem.QueueStateEvent on synthetic XR controller/HMD devices in the normal Dynamic player input update, through production Input Actions and interactors. Home uses a synthetic keyboard. No SelectEnter/SelectExit calls are made by this validator.
limitations: Official simulator presence is checked, then its state writer is disabled. OS keyboard/mouse simulator controls, physical headset input, learning outcomes, comfort, historical accuracy, frame time and executable builds are not tested. Public-API state tests and pose fixtures are labelled separately from input-driven tests. Screenshots are monocular editor captures requiring visual review. after-inspect, after-welcome, after-playing and after-help copy one unchanged production camera pose and field of view; no before image is recreated. -panel-closeup and -diagram-closeup files are temporary diagnostic camera views, not production views. Animation QA checks an explicitly schematic mechanism, not physical airflow or an exact historical pump/telephone reconstruction. No text overflow proves only layout containment, not readability in a headset; resolved font sizes are recorded.
